summary: Banco Bradesco S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting insider shareholding disclosures under Brazilian regulations. The filing details positions held by controlling families, board members, and executive officers as of April 2026, with no material changes from opening to closing balances. A minor resignation of an executive officer (Nathalia Lobo Garcia Miranda) is noted. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, or other special-situation events. This is a routine beneficial ownership report required under local rules; no US-equivalent M&A process exists. The filing lacks any actionable transaction for event-driven analysis.
